description: Calculates the 2025-2028 enhanced deduction for seniors under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (P.L. 119-21) as IRS Schedule 1-A Part V does: $6,000 per person age 65 or older by Dec 31, each reduced by 6% of MAGI over $75,000 ($150,000 joint). On a joint return the reduction applies to each spouse's $6,000. Married filing separately gets $0. Figures copied from irs.gov in Oct 2026.

filing_status.description: Federal filing status. married_filing_separately cannot claim these deductions.

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income in USD: Form 1040 line 11b plus excluded Puerto Rico and foreign income (Schedule 1-A Part I).

spouse_age_65_or_older.description: Joint returns only. True if your spouse is 65 or older on Dec 31.

spouse_birth_date.description: Joint returns only. Spouse birth date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tax_year.description: Tax year, 2025 to 2028. The deductions end after 2028.

taxpayer_age_65_or_older.description: True if you are 65 or older on Dec 31 of the tax year. Ignored if taxpayer_birth_date is given.

name: calculate_senior_deduction
title: Enhanced deduction for seniors (65+)
